fixtures.description: CommonMark basics: paragraphs, inline styles, headings, lists, blockquotes, links, images, code, horizontal rules, escaping
GFM extensions: tables, task lists, strikethrough, autolinks
GitHub-style alert blocks: NOTE, TIP, IMPORTANT, WARNING, CAUTION, plus regular blockquote
Footnote definitions and references, multi-paragraph footnote, undefined reference
Wikilink syntax: [[link]], [[link|label]], [[path/to/page]], [[page#section]]
Raw HTML from the strict allowlist: kbd, details, summary, sub, sup, mark, abbr, br
Fenced code blocks with and without language tags, indented code, inline code, diff code
Heading hierarchy and slug deduplication for outline extraction
XSS attack vectors: javascript: links, vbscript:, data: URIs, file:, event handlers, SVG scripts, encoded URLs, object/embed, script/iframe/form/meta/style tags
DOM clobbering: form/anchor/img with id/name attributes that shadow globals, nested forms
Protocol tricks: mixed case, whitespace, newlines, tabs, HTML entities, URL encoding, custom schemes, data: variants, file: variants
Encoded URL attacks: double encoding, unicode, HTML entities, mixed encoding, null bytes, UTF-8 overlong
SVG attack vectors: inline SVG with script, onload, external references, xlink, data URI, foreignObject, animate, set, style
Path traversal in links and images: relative, absolute, URL-encoded, double-encoded, null byte, UNC, mixed separators
Pathological input: deeply nested lists, nested blockquotes, very long line, many emphasis markers, nested emphasis, excessive heading hashes, repeated rules, malformed structure
Bypass attempts: percent-encoded colons, encoded scheme names, control char injection, mixed-case with encoding, style injection, xlink, srcset, source/track/poster, nested anchors, base href

CSS injection via style attributes on span/pre: position overlays, background:url exfiltration, expression/behavior/-moz-binding script vectors, comment-hidden declarations; safe layout properties preserved
Mermaid diagrams: flowchart, sequence, git graph, pie, and malicious mermaid with XSS payloads
Math expressions: inline math, block/display math, mixed inline and block, special symbols, pathological input, math in code blocks (should NOT render)
Valid DESIGN.md with front matter and token definitions: colors, typography, spacing, radii
Invalid DESIGN.md with deliberate errors: not-a-color, missing refs, bad units, bad values
YAML front matter with title, description, lang, author, date, tags, nested objects, numbers, booleans
Syntax highlighting fixtures: TypeScript, Python, Rust, Diff, JSON, plain, Shell, SQL
